name: Payment Sentinel
problem: Payment failures create repair queues and delay straight-through processing.
solution: A predictive payment-risk prototype connecting a model experiment, a prediction API and an operations-facing interface.
decisions: Compared Logistic Regression and XGBoost on synthetic payments.
Connected prediction to understandable risk explanations and a review workflow.
Kept proposed repair logic separate from the prediction model.
evidence: Prior project discussions describe a Colab experiment, Render API and Lovable interface. Training used synthetic transactions; production impact has not been established.
next: Attach the notebook, model card, current evaluation report and a recorded walkthrough. Confirm personal versus team contribution before interviews.

name: AI Storytelling Studio
problem: Creating a narrated short requires coordinating scripts, scenes, images, voice and rendering.
solution: A local creative workflow with human review between story development and generated media.
decisions: Structured the work into approved milestones rather than one opaque generation.
Benchmarked image generation against an Apple M1 memory and latency budget.
Kept motion generation behind an approval step.
evidence: Project discussions record local backend/frontend tests and a rendered Midnight Line narrated slideshow. The Runway workflow was implemented but disabled; paid motion generation is not evidenced.
next: Add a short export, architecture, selected test output and a sanitized source repository. Localhost addresses are not public demos.

name: PickWise
problem: Beginner affiliate creators spend time switching between product research, graphics and publishing tools.
solution: A supervised workflow to research up to five products, draft a Pinterest pin and matching guide, check evidence and request approval.
decisions: Bound product research and correction attempts.
Use authorized product photos or a text-based comparison.
Invalidate approval whenever the content changes; publish the guide before the pin.
evidence: Team 8 capstone canvas explicitly states design proposal, not implemented or evaluated. The 60–70+ minute baseline is retrospective, not a timed benchmark. Coach is a stretch role.
next: Build one complete content package and run the golden cases. Measure active human effort separately from runtime. Team: Aswin, Sushmita and Vinil Bandaru.

name: VERITAS SCREEN
problem: Sanctions-screening workflows need to distinguish actionable matches from noisy alerts.
solution: A capstone screening demonstration with synthetic cases, staged decisions and analyst-review paths.
decisions: Make release, analyst-review and block paths visible.
Use synthetic cases to demonstrate decision behavior.
Separate aspirational false-alert reduction from measured performance.
evidence: Retrieved history describes a clickable HTML demo and leadership materials. Co-created with Aswin Govarthanan. Original runnable source has not been recovered in this portfolio.
next: Recover the demo and deck; document which stages are simulated and how the screening quality would be evaluated.

name: EV Charger Health Diagnosis
problem: Operations teams must inspect large volumes of OCPP messages to investigate charging issues.
solution: A specified operations copilot combining deterministic event processing with explainable LLM diagnosis.
decisions: Reconstruct sessions and compress repetitive telemetry before model reasoning.
Separate observed facts from inferred root causes.
Return supporting evidence, missing data and suggested actions.
evidence: Project-Context.txt establishes the product and technical objectives, not a deployed implementation. Sub-minute investigation is a goal, not a measured result.
next: Create a sanitized sample-log demo and evaluate diagnosis against expert-labeled incidents.

name: Release Intelligence Dashboard
problem: Release information spread across tasks and inconsistent labels makes product reporting difficult.
solution: A release reporting dashboard developed with Lovable and Supabase, with product/month filters and PDF export work.
decisions: Normalize hotfix and XP release labels.
Exclude operational configuration categories from product-release views.
Iterate on missing versions and export readability.
evidence: Prior discussions document dashboard iterations. The current live build and source have not been inspected. This is product tooling; no AI feature is claimed.
next: Recreate with fictional products and sample releases before sharing externally. Employer data and internal task details are excluded.

name: OCPP Knowledge & Log Lab
problem: Protocol documentation and raw charger events are difficult to navigate during investigation.
solution: Exploration of OCPP knowledge ingestion in Langflow and charger-event analysis.
decisions: Explore retrieval separately from operational diagnosis.
Inspect timestamp completeness before reasoning about event order.
Keep raw employer and customer logs out of public artifacts.
evidence: Prior discussions reference ingestion and log-analysis experiments. Retrieval quality and a working public service are not established.
next: Publish a small public-specification experiment with citations and a retrieval evaluation set. Keep distinct from the diagnosis concept.

name: TravelMate AI
problem: Travelers coordinate accommodation, transport and rides across disconnected choices.
solution: A React/Tailwind concept interface with optional selections, dynamic totals, mock payment and itinerary export.
decisions: Let travelers choose only the services they need.
Show totals as selections change.
Demonstrate the journey using mock transactions.
evidence: Retrieved history describes a responsive frontend prototype. Live booking APIs and an AI backend are not evidenced.
next: Recover the original source and walkthrough; describe the AI proposition separately from implemented UI.

name: Agent Behavior Teardown
tag: Test the behavior behind the promise
problem: Conversational interfaces can appear more autonomous than the actions they actually perform.
solution: A structured assessment of Copilot in Teams using happy-path, missing-information, ambiguity, high-stakes and probe scenarios.
decisions: Judge observable tool use and execution rather than the agent label.
Probe escalation and uncertainty handling.
Translate failure modes into product and guardrail improvements.
evidence: Completed course analysis is described in retrieved files. This is an evaluation case study, not a product implementation.
next: Add sanitized test inputs, observed outputs and the assessment rubric.
